text: The bug is on line 22: `round(total_cents / people)` uses floating-point division and round-half-to-even, so `200/3 → 67` (sum 201), and other cases end up 1 cent short. The fix is to use exact integer arithmetic: base share `total_cents // people`, and distribute the remainder `total_cents % people` to the first few shares.

arguments.old:
share = round(total_cents / people)
    shares = [share] * people
    leftover = total_cents - share * people
    for i in range(leftover):
        shares[i] += 1
    return shares
arguments.new:
share = total_cents // people
    shares = [share] * people
    leftover = total_cents % people
    for i in range(leftover):
        shares[i] += 1
    return shares
